rationales: Guessing does not systematically split a problem into smaller parts.
Prototyping creates an early model rather than dividing a problem.
Divide and conquer breaks a complex problem into smaller subproblems.
Acting it out uses role-play or simulation, not problem decomposition.
Analyzing the problem is the first step before planning a solution.
Determining is too vague and is not the usual first step described here.
“Un-understanding” is not a problem-solving step.
Planning generally follows understanding and analyzing the problem.
The decimal system uses the ten digits from 0 through 9.
The decimal system does not use digits 1 through 16.
The decimal system does not use digits 2 through 8.
The digits 0 through 7 are used in the octal system.
(10)₂ equals decimal 2, not 3.
(11)₂ equals decimal 3.
(1111)₂ equals decimal 15.
(1000)₂ equals decimal 8.
A protocol is an agreed set of rules for communication between computers.
A transmission medium is the channel through which information travels.
A sender transmits information but does not define the communication rules.
A receiver accepts information but does not define the communication rules.
A DoS attack attempts to make a machine or network unavailable to users.
Phishing tricks users into revealing information or taking unsafe actions.
Hacking is unauthorized access or activity, not specifically an availability attack.
Piracy is the unauthorized copying or use of protected material.
<ol> creates an ordered list and does not specify an image URL.
<dl> creates a description list and does not specify an image URL.
The src attribute specifies the image file URL.
</br> is not the attribute used to specify an image URL.
“Prepared solution” does not clearly identify a solution reached without algorithms or planning.
“Candid solution” is not a recognized problem-solving category that answers the question.
“Strategied solution” is unclear and does not provide a standard answer to the question.
“Best solution” describes quality, not whether algorithms or planning were used.
The intended interpretation is a yes-or-no question with a Boolean outcome.
A categorical proposition makes a claim about a category rather than asking for a yes-or-no value.
A moral proposition concerns right and wrong, which is not the topic here.
The intended answer is the Boolean option, so this is not the best choice.
HTML is not generally classified as a programming language.
HTML is a markup language used to structure web content.
HTML is a markup language, not both a programming and markup language in this classification.
HTML is correctly classified as a markup language.
An ordered list is one possible list type, not the general name for a list inside a list.
An unordered list is one possible list type, not the general name for a list inside a list.
A list contained within another list is called a nested list.
A definition list is a list of terms and descriptions, not the general name for a list inside a list.
FTP stands for File Transfer Protocol.
“Fix Transfer Protocol” is not the expansion of FTP.
“File Total Protocol” is not the expansion of FTP.
“Found Transfer Protocol” is not the expansion of FTP.
“Disk object System” is not the expansion of DOS in this context.
“Disk off System” is not the expansion of DOS in this context.
This option appears to intend “Denial of Service,” although “Dedial” is misspelled.
“Disk on Service” is not the expansion of DOS in this context.
Soft lifting is a type of software piracy involving unauthorized copying.
Liability is not a type of software piracy.
Client-server overuse is a recognized form of software piracy.
Online piracy is a type of software piracy.
Division has lower precedence than logical NOT.
Assignment has lower precedence than logical NOT.
The relational greater-than operator has lower precedence than logical NOT.
The logical NOT operator has the highest precedence among these options.
